scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the official Ixalan / Rivals of Ixalan Magic Story episodes (2017-09-06 to 2018-02-21). These episodes have no recap paragraphs, so quotes are short scene passages located with `story_claim_pipeline.py find`. Not an exhaustive reading; the two Planeswalker's Guide pages are cached but not modelled.

claims.subject: jace_beleren

quotes.quote: caused the man to realize how little exercise he must have been getting before he lost his memory.

claims.summary: Jace wakes on Ixalan with no memory of who he is.
claims.limitation: The episode calls him only 'the man'; identifying him as Jace rests on the episode title ('Jace, Alone') and later episodes.

claims.subject: huatli

quotes.quote: She tried to stand and face her foe when something deep within her chest sparked. Suddenly, without pain, Huatli began to feel herself coming apart.

claims.summary: Huatli's spark ignites in a moment of mortal danger.

claims.subject: nicol_bolas

quotes.quote: "Vraska, assassin of the Ochran," he said in a voice like thunder, "I'm glad you received my invitation. I am Nicol Bolas, and I would like to hire you for the use of your talents."
"I accept your terms," said Vraska.

claims.summary: Nicol Bolas hires Vraska, and she accepts his terms.

claims.subject: nicol_bolas

quotes.quote: Nicol Bolas smiled. "I can make you Guildmaster of the Golgari, Vraska."

claims.summary: Bolas offers to make Vraska Guildmaster of the Golgari.

claims.subject: kumena

quotes.quote: He was nearing the golden city of Orazca, the resting place of the Immortal Sun.
Kumena stepped onto the Immortal Sun and took that power, his power.

claims.summary: Kumena reaches Orazca and stands on the Immortal Sun, taking its power.

claims.subject: jace_beleren

quotes.quote: "That's me," he said with amusement. "Jace Beleren: Living Guildpact, telepath, illusionist, maze guy."

claims.summary: By Rivals of Ixalan Jace knows himself again as Jace Beleren, the Living Guildpact.

claims.subject: immortal_sun

quotes.quote: "That's the symbol that appeared over our heads every time we tried to planeswalk," he said. "It's the symbol of the Azorius."
"Why does Nicol Bolas want an artifact that imprisons Planeswalkers?" she asked in hushed fear.
Both the Immortal Sun and the barrier. Perhaps they were one and the same after all.

claims.summary: An Azorius symbol blocked planeswalking on Ixalan; the Immortal Sun is described as an artifact that imprisons Planeswalkers, and it and the barrier vanish together.
claims.limitation: Each quote is a character's observation or speculation ('Perhaps they were one and the same'); no narration states the mechanism.

claims.subject: azor

quotes.quote: The sphinx performed a feat of hieromancy that no being had ever attempted and none would ever be able to match, severing his spark to create the artifact he called the Immortal Sun.

claims.summary: Azor severed his own spark to create the Immortal Sun on Torrezon.

claims.subject: azor

quotes.quote: "The Immortal Sun will seal you in your prison, Planeswalker."
Azor sputtered through his pain, "Our intention was to imprison Nicol Bolas—"
Azor was left without a spark, and his prison without a prisoner.

claims.summary: Azor and Ugin meant the Immortal Sun to imprison Nicol Bolas; the trap never received its prisoner.

claims.subject: nicol_bolas

quotes.quote: The Spirit Dragon tried to escape, but was caught in a tempest of fire and claws. He hit the ground.
And Nicol Bolas planeswalked away, never to return, for he had won.

claims.summary: Bolas defeats Ugin before Azor's trap can be sprung (the Sabotage flashback; the scene is not named as Tarkir in these quotes).

claims.subject: immortal_sun

quotes.quote: The Immortal Sun vanished beneath their feet, and Huatli, Tishana, Vona, and Angrath all tumbled through the floor into the empty room below.

claims.summary: The Immortal Sun vanishes from Orazca; the quotes do not say who took it.

claims.subject: angrath

quotes.quote: "SEE YOU NEVER, PATHETIC FOOLS!" as he planeswalked away.

claims.summary: With the Immortal Sun gone, Angrath planeswalks away from Ixalan.

claims.subject: huatli

quotes.quote: "It's a pleasure to meet you, Saheeli. My name is Huatli. It's my first time away from my world," Huatli said.

claims.summary: On her first planeswalk, Huatli meets Saheeli Rai on Kaladesh.

claims.subject: legion_of_dusk

quotes.quote: "They seek an end to their vampirism," she had said. "They crave eternal life without needing blood. The Immortal Sun was stolen from their monasteries, and so they ventured to the sea to reclaim it.

claims.summary: Amelia tells Vraska the vampires seek the Immortal Sun, which was stolen from their monasteries.
claims.limitation: Second-hand: Amelia's account as remembered by Vraska; the theft claim is not narrated.

claims.subject: sun_empire

quotes.quote: The people have spoken, and the Sun Empire emerged victorious to claim control of Orazca!

claims.summary: Canon outcome (chosen by a player vote): the Sun Empire claims Orazca.

claims.subject: river_heralds

quotes.quote: However, we were prepared no matter which faction won, and the remaining (now non-canon) stories are too great not to share.

claims.summary: Wizards published non-canon alternate endings in which another faction (for example the River Heralds) holds Orazca.
claims.limitation: Explicitly non-canon per Wizards; kept only so queries do not mistake the alternate endings for canon.

claims.subject: immortal_sun

quotes.quote: Secure in the ancient golden city of Orazca, the Immortal Sun is an artifact of mythic power

claims.summary: The Immortal Sun lies in the golden city of Orazca.

claims.subject: legion_of_dusk

quotes.quote: And as the Legion of Dusk seeks to conquer Ixalan

claims.summary: The Legion of Dusk seeks to conquer Ixalan.

claims.subject: beckett_brass

quotes.quote: they refer to themselves as the Brazen Coalition, in honor of Captain Brass, who now commands the largest fleet of the coalition

claims.summary: The Brazen Coalition is named in honor of Captain (now Admiral) Beckett Brass, who commands its largest fleet.
claims.limitation: The guide says she commands the largest fleet; 'leader_of' summarises that the coalition is named for her.

claims.subject: legion_of_dusk

quotes.quote: Torrezon now lies entirely under the Legion's control

claims.summary: Torrezon lies entirely under the Legion of Dusk's control.

claims.subject: elenda

quotes.quote: The last custodian of the precious artifact, a woman named Elenda

claims.summary: Elenda was the last custodian of the Immortal Sun in Torrezon.

claims.subject: elenda

quotes.quote: Soon, many of Torrezon's nobles undertook Elenda's transformative ritual, and it became known as the Rite of Redemption by the church.

claims.summary: Elenda's vampiric transformation became the church's Rite of Redemption.

claims.subject: apatzec_intli

quotes.quote: The new ruler of the Sun Empire, responsible for the current mood of expansion and conquest, is a fierce man named Apatzec

claims.summary: Apatzec Intli III is the current ruler of the Sun Empire.

claims.subject: chacanto_intli

quotes.quote: closely associated with Chacanto Intli, the empire's founder

claims.summary: Chacanto Intli founded the Sun Empire.

claims.subject: caparocti_sunborn

quotes.quote: Caparocti Sunborn is the holy champion of Pachatupa

claims.summary: Caparocti Sunborn is the holy champion of Pachatupa.

claims.subject: tishana

quotes.quote: The shamans are known by the rivers' names: Tishana, Kumena, Pashona, Vuhana, Mitica, Notana, Falani, Tuvasa, and Kopala.

claims.summary: Tishana is one of the nine River Herald river shamans.
claims.limitation: The sentence lists the shamans by river name; River Herald membership comes from the surrounding section.

claims.subject: tishana

quotes.quote: Tishana, my mentor, is here with me, guiding me

claims.summary: Kopala, narrating The Shapers, names Tishana as his mentor.
claims.limitation: The narrator is Kopala (the page is headed KOPALA).

claims.subject: kumena

quotes.quote: At their head stands Kumena, their Shaper.

claims.summary: Kumena stands at the head of a group of merfolk as their Shaper.
claims.limitation: 'Their' refers to a band of merfolk, not the whole River Heralds; read as leadership of a faction within them.

claims.subject: tishana

quotes.quote: she sighed in relief when Tishana's summoned river rushed past her and toward her fleeing enemies

claims.summary: During the race to Orazca, Tishana's summoned river helps Huatli against their enemies.

claims.subject: jace_beleren

quotes.quote: Her heart leapt as she ran, Jace at her side and her crew at her back.

claims.summary: Jace runs at Vraska's side with her crew in the race.

claims.subject: vona

quotes.quote: working the spell that would bind her life to serve the crown and church in perpetuity
Vona had volunteered to lead the first ship that left port.

claims.summary: Vona bound her life to the crown and church and led the first Legion ship out of port.
claims.limitation: Legion membership is inferred from service to Torrezon's crown and church.

claims.subject: mavren_fein

quotes.quote: I have conquered the waves and death itself, praise Saint Elenda!

claims.summary: The hierophant (Mavren Fein) arriving at Fort Adanto praises Saint Elenda.
claims.limitation: The speaker is introduced as a hierophant and named Mavren Fein later in the episode.

claims.subject: breeches

quotes.quote: He felt a tap on his shoulder and turned to find Breeches, a goblin as talented at knot-tying as he was at yelling.

claims.summary: Breeches the goblin is one of the crew of The Belligerent.
claims.limitation: Crew membership comes from the scene setting aboard The Belligerent; modelled as membership of the ship.

claims.subject: amelia

quotes.quote: Amelia, quartermaster and one of the two helmsmages, was more than happy to demonstrate.

claims.summary: Amelia is the quartermaster and one of the two helmsmages of The Belligerent.
claims.limitation: The quote does not name the ship; the scene is aboard The Belligerent.

remaining: Targeted extraction, not exhaustive: Shapers, Something Else Entirely and both Race episodes are uncited
The two Planeswalker's Guide to Ixalan pages are cached but not modelled
Who removed the Immortal Sun from Ixalan is not asserted from these pages
